notes: Retain one unsigned 16-bit sample per 0.30 mm geometry-grid vertex. The canonical surface build asset remains 900 x 900 at 0.20 mm/pixel (127 PPI); the geometry adapter extracts the aspect-preserved physical repeat tile recorded in build metadata. No thresholds, depth classes, run-length quantization, or other height-level reduction are permitted. Peak memory is bounded by building one module per Node/WASM process and applying one relief surface patch at a time.
